name: Yogurt Parfait
steps: Wash berries and dry them thoroughly; halve any large strawberries.
Spoon one quarter of the yogurt into four clear glasses, then add half the granola and half the berries in even layers.
Add the remaining yogurt, then remaining granola and berries. Drizzle maple syrup evenly over the four glasses.
Serve immediately so the granola stays crisp, or keep the granola separate until serving.
tips: Use unsweetened yogurt to balance the fruit and syrup.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
